verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a SaaS compliance product, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about, but nothing in the evidence documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server, llms.txt and CLI probes are developer and agent-integration surfaces for other stories, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
